headline: Fiscal Council report: The state is financing the maintenance of a failed agrarian model; every further "sweeping under the carpet" increases economic costs
summary: The Fiscal Council said Serbian agriculture is in a very poor state and needs fundamental reform. Its analysis covers production, prices and agrarian policy.
why: Agricultural subsidies are a major item of government spending, and farm output and prices influence food inflation and the fiscal balance.
